series.name: Table C — Axpert V PF1
series.notes: Adds fault 56 + warnings W11-W14; drops W16/W32 vs VM III. Battery-not-connected numbering delta.

meaning.en: Battery wiring open / not detected at startup.
meaning.ur: Battery wiring khuli / start par detect nahin hui.

solutions.en: Check wire connection and battery polarity.
solutions.ur: Wire connection aur polarity check karein.

solutions.en: Repair or replace main board if wiring OK.
solutions.ur: Agar wiring theek ho to main board ki marammat karein ya badal dein.

source.title: Voltronic Power Axpert V PF1 manual (official)

notes.en: Not present on VM III table. InfiniSolar counterpart: fault 56 'Battery disconnected' / warning W19. Platform reference entry (table source SRC-VPF1). Local brand rows may match but keep brand code space separate.
notes.ur: VM III table mein maujood nahin. InfiniSolar counterpart: fault 56 'Battery disconnected' / warning W19. Yeh platform ka reference entry hai (table source SRC-VPF1). Local brand ki rows mil sakti hain, magar brand ka code space alag rakhein.

codes.blinkPattern: Fault icon lit; red LED solid; continuous buzzer.

meaning.en: Battery not detected (warning stage; V PF1 numbers the 'battery not connected' icon W11).
meaning.ur: Battery detect nahin hui (warning stage; V PF1 ne 'battery not connected' icon ko W11 number diya hai).

solutions.en: Repair/replace main board if wiring OK.
solutions.ur: Agar wiring theek ho to main board ki marammat karein ya badal dein.

source.title: Voltronic Power Axpert V PF1 manual (official)

notes.en: NUMBERING DELTA: same event = blank code on VM III, W19 on InfiniSolar VII, 'BP' on VII WP, W11 on V PF1, fault 56 on V PF1/MKS/Infini. Platform reference entry (table source SRC-VPF1). Local brand rows may match but keep brand code space separate.
notes.ur: NUMBERING DELTA: same event = VM III par blank code, InfiniSolar VII par W19, VII WP par 'BP', V PF1 par W11, aur V PF1/MKS/Infini par fault 56. Yeh platform ka reference entry hai (table source SRC-VPF1). Local brand ki rows mil sakti hain, magar brand ka code space alag rakhein.

codes.blinkPattern: Icon flashing; red LED flashing; beep per Table A rules for unnumbered battery icon (None).

solutions.en: Restart; if persists, return to repair center (KB mapping to generic restart-then-service rows).
solutions.ur: Restart karein; phir bhi rahe to marammat ke markaz wapas jayein (KB mapping).
